title: Recording Savings and Spending
introduction: Explore recording savings and spending using everyday examples.
definition: A savings record tracks money received, money spent and the amount left. Subtract spending from available money. Saving means keeping money for future needs.

exercises.question: Receive RM5, spend RM2. Remaining RM?
Save RM2 each of three days. Total RM?
Have RM6, receive RM3. Total RM?
Have RM10, spend RM4. Remaining RM?
Save 20 sen and 50 sen. Total sen?
Have 90 sen, spend 30 sen. Remaining sen?

summary: A savings record tracks money received, money spent and the amount left. Subtract spending from available money. Saving means keeping money for future needs.
